claims.existing_text:
Latvia ✔️ Yes
  • All EAA products and most of services (financial services, e-books, e-commerce, water transport): Consumer Rights Protection Centre (PTAC)
  • Electronic communications: Public Utilities Commission(SPRK)
  • Access to audiovisual media services: National Electronic Mass Media Council (NEPLP)
  • Specific elements of air passenger services: Civil Aviation Agency (CAA)
  • Bus and domestic rail services: State Ltd. Road Transport Administration (ATD)
  • International rail services: State Railway Administration (VDA)
  • Self-service terminals used in public transport like buses, trams, and trolleybuses: Municipalities
For CRPC via e-mail pasts@ptac.gov.lv you can report about exemptions, non-compliances (also recalls) in 🇬🇧 English or 🇱🇻 Latvian. National legal acts:
  • Preču un pakalpojumu piekļūstamības likums
  • Preču un pakalpojumu piekļūstamības prasības
These documents have not been officially translated to English by the State Language Centre.

Reporting may be accepted in English even if the official language is Latvian. In some cases, documentation translation to Latvian may still be needed, especially for public usage.
